title_zh: 织密养老服务网 让老人们的笑脸更灿烂
title_en: Lhasa Weaves a Denser Elderly Care Service Network to Brighten Seniors' Smiles
summary_zh: 拉萨市持续推进养老服务体系建设，织密基层养老服务网络，提升高原老年人的生活保障与服务可及性。
summary_en: Lhasa is expanding its elderly care service network to improve service access and living support for senior residents on the plateau.
